debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting. Enable only when diagnosing issues.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Must be writable by the gddccontrol service user.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads used for background polling of monitor status. Adjust based on system load.

poll_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between automatic checks of monitor status and compliance with configured settings.

i2c_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for I2C communication attempts. Increase if you see frequent timeouts.

i2c_retry_limit.description: Maximum number of retries for failed I2C operations before marking a monitor as unreachable.

monitors.description: List of monitor configurations. Each entry defines a physical or virtual monitor with its I2C address and settings.

i2c_addr.description: Decimal I2C address of the monitor (e.g., 0x3D = 61). Must match hardware.

enabled.description: Whether this monitor is actively controlled by gddccontrol.

default_brightness.description: Default brightness level (0–100) to apply when restoring or starting.

default_contrast.description: Default contrast level (0–100) to apply when restoring or starting.

restore_on_start.description: Whether to restore stored or default settings for this monitor on daemon start.

gamma_path.description: Optional path to a custom gamma correction file (e.g., .icm or .csp). Leave empty to use internal defaults.

allowed_users.description: List of system usernames allowed to control monitor settings via the API. Empty list = unrestricted (not recommended in production).

api_port.description: TCP port for the HTTP-based control API. Must be free and accessible.

api_host.description: Network interface to bind the API to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost-only, '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).
